items.title: Fresh developments on peaceful protests and police detentions in Delhi
items.text: The Indian Express reports on developments around protests in Delhi, police detentions, and the handling of peaceful assemblies. Students should distinguish reported facts from allegations and follow official court updates.

items.title: Election Commission and public trust remain in focus
items.text: Current reporting highlights calls for accountability and debate over the credibility of election administration. The issue relates to institutional independence, transparency, and electoral processes.

items.title: India condemns attack on Riyadh airport and expresses solidarity with Saudi Arabia
items.text: Reporting on 12 October says India condemned an attack on Riyadh airport. The incident highlights civilian safety and the wider regional security situation.

items.title: RBI tightens rules for foreign-exchange derivative positions
items.text: Recent business reporting says the Reserve Bank of India has tightened rules relating to foreign-exchange derivative positions amid pressure on the rupee. The development concerns currency-market stability and risk management.

items.title: Indian equity markets watch corporate earnings and global cues
items.text: Market coverage for 12 October points to attention on early market indicators, upcoming quarterly earnings, and international economic conditions. Market forecasts can change during the trading session.

items.title: Digital public infrastructure remains a focus in technology and policy discussions
items.text: Current analysis discusses how digital public infrastructure can help reduce service-delivery costs and expand access, while raising questions about equitable distribution of benefits.

items.title: Agrivoltaics discussed as a way to combine farming and solar power
items.text: A current opinion piece describes agrivoltaics, which combines agricultural production with solar-energy generation on the same land, as a possible way to support farm incomes and clean energy.

items.title: Daily school news briefs cover national, international, business and sports updates
items.text: Daily student news briefings provide a concise way to review developments across major topics. Learners should check original reporting before treating a headline as a confirmed fact.
